The top could also be read as a bowl or ornament placed on the sign (decor). I read it as the sign's own top cap, so this call is uncertain. No receding side face is drawn.

It is still comparable to the accepted bus shelter and would not look out of place beside these references, so it passes narrowly despite being slightly lower in density.
